data.one_liner: A simple web scraper to extract HTML tags and attributes into lists and maps.
data.what_it_does: It loads web pages via HTTP and allows scraping of HTML elements, titles, attributes, and script variables using CSS selectors. The package parses HTML into documents that can be queried programmatically.
use_when: You need to extract data from a website via HTML scraping
You want to parse HTML elements into Dart lists and maps
avoid_when: The target website relies heavily on JavaScript rendering that static HTTP requests cannot load
You require an official or robust API provided by the platform
strengths: Simple API with clear methods for loading pages and extracting elements
Supports both Dart and Flutter projects
Includes helper methods for retrieving element titles, attributes, and script variables
weaknesses: Depends on static HTML loading and may not handle complex single-page applications rendered entirely with client-side JavaScript
Website layout changes can easily break scraping selectors
